programme.desc: Mojo needs to deliver a pizza to a very hard-to-reach island, but some stubborn seabirds have their eye on the pizza. Will Mojo have to go supersonic to get past them?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning out his cupboard when he comes across Bucky, his old rocking horse. He wants to show the Squirrels how to ride the horse but Bucky is very old and needs to be fixed first. The Squirrels help Duggee to mend Bucky so he feels brand new again and in return they get to ride him. Cowboy, circus trapeze artist, knight in shining armour, racing jockey! It's all happening in the clubhouse! Yee-haw!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Oh dear, poor Norrie is sick. Can the Squirrels think of something to cheer her up? Happy suggests a get well soon card! What a good idea! Glitter, glue, feathers and paint! Duggee takes the Squirrels to visit Norrie, but along the way they come across a hungry panda, a poorly frog and a coughing caterpillar. Can the Squirrels think of how to cheer them up too?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The kids want Mum and Dad to play whale watching, but they are tired after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help flip him off, but they still need to find one more friend.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Glitch has attached huge rocket boosters to Grim HQ in an attempt to become the first Grandmaster in space. As he thunders up into the night sky, it looks like he may actually do it this time. Then the boosters splutter to a stop and he crashes back to Earth. Glitch clambers to his feet amongst the wreckage of Grim HQ and demands the Grimbots find him another spaceship. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters arrive at the Seattle Space Needle, a huge spire with a futuristic viewing platform made to look like a flying saucer. Suddenly the ground begins to shake. Kyan thinks it's his stomach, Xuli thinks it's an earthquake, but Foz spots the real cause - Glitch has attached four of his huge rockets to the saucer to turn the Space Needle into a spaceship!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter is forced to reveal the location of the secret treehouse to Flopsy and Mopsy, the girls decide to hang out in Peter's den - just as Old Brown launches a treetop attack!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers for more deep sea adventures. The Octonauts wade through a swamp to find a lost flamingo chick before hungry predators do.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One Hundred shows us what she's made of in a big song about being big. Learn all about the number 100 with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. When T gets stuck on top of a mountain, A, E, I, O and U come to the rescue.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Flutter buys a new fishy pet from slippery salesman Mervyn, but the Piripenguins get stuck in its gloopy slime. Can the friends find a solution to their sticky situation?

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Twiggy has a funny tummy on the day of his performance. Nothing the doctors try works, not even the cure for froggy moths! Zog wonders if there is something else bothering Twiggy.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston needs Mojo’s racer top speed to get his new plane off the ground. But when his flight goes wrong, Mojo and Bo have to take to the air in Mojo’s jet top to help him down!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'Pando went to sleep in my bed and I didn't like that 'cos it's mine.' Bing and Pando are both tired but insist on one last game of hide-and-seek before bed. Pando finds a great hiding place under the covers of Bing's bed, but by the time Bing finds him he is fast asleep. Bing is tired too and gets upset when he thinks there is nowhere left for him to sleep, but Flop and Padget find a solution.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘strawberry’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We grow strawberries, pick them and enjoy eating yummy ones. There are skipping and space strawberries, and Dee even does the samba with one! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: It’s almost bedtime, but Maddie doesn’t want to brush her teeth. Dad tells her all about the mysterious pearly whites (aka her teeth!), and how they sometimes start to sing when they’re tickled. Really, singing teeth? It couldn’t be true… Could it?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Fine Forest is buzzing with excitement as the Fine Forest Drums Festival approaches. The Piggies make a lot of drums for everyone, but they mysteriously disappear. The Piggies create a huge drum and hide inside to uncover this mystery.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a lady trying to make a picnic bench, fitting planks of wood together. Her dog comes to tell her it is time for a walk. Whilst she is away, the Twirlywoos start fitting together the planks of wood - but are they following the instructions for the picnic bench or making something completely different? The Twirlywoo Screen is showing a collection of bones. Fitting together, they make up a skeleton, a dancing skeleton. The Twirlywoos join in the dance.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends visit a fairy-tale castle for a musical adventure, while Fairy Godmother Tumble has a fairy-tale adventure of his own – will Tumble Ted make it to the ball?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa's bouncy ball makes a mess in Home Dome, where the other Teletubbies have just sat down to eat bowls of yummy tubby custard. In Tummy Tales, the children blow up a big bouncy ball and play with it in the park.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Remi, Otis, George, Holly, DJ, Luke and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Cardboard Tubes which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate cardboard tubes inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The popular song ‘Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children plant sunflower seeds in decorated pots to grow beautiful flowers, learn British Sign Language signs for garden, grow and pretty, then sing and sign Mary, Mary, Quite Contrary.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron and the Buds explore the wonderful world of climbing plants, discovering how ivy, sweet peas and raspberries grow tall and reach up for the sun in clever, twisty ways!

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Giraffe Twiggy is feeling happy but doesn’t know why. Her friends tell her what makes them happy. Hamza looks for antelope in the wild and spends time with Alcatraz the tortoise.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou helps Sorry with her anxiety.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey's house has fairies! Tails are being braided, stickers are everywhere, and Mum's got a peg beard. Now the family must band together to hunt for these invisible mischief-makers.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When the Squirrels find Duggee playing the saxophone, they want to have a go, too. Several pots, balloons, tins, tubes and some water later, and the Squirrels are making music. And boy, are they loud!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Sing along with Orange as she helps Indigo and Violet to colour a rainbow.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Harrison wants to find out all about crane flies in today’s episode. Rory and Sandy head to a nature reserve to try to spot them, and Chantelle meets a bug expert in in his garden. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of Harrison’s questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, crane flies are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Rory, Sandy and Zoe make their legs grow with the help of some stilts, as they discover what it’s like having long legs like a crane fly!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: It’s Mummy’s birthday! Henry, Sophie and Mama go on a secret shopping trip to find the perfect present. Back at home, Henry plans out a treasure map and sends Mummy on a heroic birthday adventure. Can she brave the hot lava? And will she find her presents?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen and Small pretend to be knights in the cafe today. Small finds out how naan bread is made, and they cook a perfect dhal recipe for Denzil the Dragon.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Newfoundland Sylvie is a big therapy dog with big soft cuddles who loves to help people when they’re worried. She and her owner Katrina visit all sorts of people every day, young and old. Sylvie and her owner Katrina are helping a girl called Akilah, who is joining the local school after arriving from a foreign country. Lots of things will be very different for her, so Sylvie will need her super heart to make her feel as welcome as possible. After meeting Akilah and her mum, along with Fred the teaching assistant, Sylvie takes her to the school hall for some lunch, stopping to admire some artwork along the way. Then Sylvie acts as Akilah’s furry tour guide on a whistlestop tour of the school, including a trip to the library, before guiding her to her new classroom to meet the teacher and all her new friends. There will be lots of new faces, and everyone will be talking in a language she’s still learning - but with Sylvie and her super heart by her side, Akilah is sure to make lots of friends.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: As the children arrive, there is a rainbow over the school. Mrs Farrell points it out to Bryn before they head inside to create their own rainbow on the carpet. The rainbow has disappeared and the rain has stopped, so some of the children go outside for a game of hide-and-seek in the forest area. They soon find a hammock and take it in turns to try it out whilst the others sing a nursery rhyme. Back inside, it’s time for some more nursery rhymes with music teacher Miss Usher. After a Hickory Dickory Dock warm-up, the children form a marching band for the Grand Old Duke of York.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: While Zoe helps Doug with his homework project about Alaska, Simon and Jess take Waffle and Evie to the shops to buy new school shoes. But Waffle's attempts to help end up causing chaos.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Baba and Lala have found something very exciting - a great big dandelion puff! When they blow the seeds away, they are very disappointed that there is no more 'fluffy'. When Mama spots one seed left, they plant it outside the burrow and wait for it to grow. Baba and Lala decide to watch the dandelion until it turns into a 'fluffy', but they must wait a long time for a new one to appear.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: As everyone huddles in Sonny’s caravan during a storm, Toad admits he’s frightened of the sound. Can Yukee find a way to use the pitter-pitter-pitter-patter of the rain to calm him?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: While looking for a spoon for her yogurt, Maddie realises that all the teaspoons have gone missing - it's like they all got up and marched off! Maddie is on hand to find a surprisingly musical way to get them back where they belong.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The Bunnies' sleeping mobile breaks, so the Piggy Builders come up with great ideas to create a new one. But the improvements amuse the Bunnies so much that they are too excited to sleep!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Uh-oh. Unlucky Thirteen falls apart whenever anyone mentions his name. Learn all about the number 13 with Numberblock Thirteen!

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: N likes to say no - but he meets his match when the dog, the cat and the pig won't help him make his bread. This episode has fun with the words dog, dig, cat, cut, pig, pick, mill, mix, hot and ten.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Mr Tumble tidies up his bedroom. Meanwhile, Justin and his friends play in a recycling band!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: A red balloon floats into Teletubbyland and Po leads the tubby phone dance in a special episode about Po's favourite colour. Po shows the Tiddlytubbies the red balloon and all of the Teletubbies watch children play in a room full of red balloons.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 85 million years to meet a giant feathered dinosaur that is as tall as a house! Along the way, he helps to protect a nest full of prehistoric eggs and gets caught in a super-sized sand storm.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the ‘chatterbox’ and remembers the day she got it… Alice is showing the kids how to make a ‘chatterbox’ when she gets a call from her mum Gloria, who lives in Canada. Mrs Juniper and Moira are bickering, and Caitlin decides to write cheeky messages in her ‘chatterbox’, which doesn’t help matters. Alice breaks some bad news to James.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are all made to help us get around cities easier. Grace first takes an electric scooter car for a spin, then shows off an amazing hydrogen train and goes for a cycle in a fold-up electric bike!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: A Very Important Pup visits Pup School for the grand opening of the school's brand new bug hotel. It's Dodge's special job to show the VIP around the school, but things don't go to plan. Dodge feels like he has let everyone down and thinks the VIP won't want to stay to open the new hotel... but things turn out very differently.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: ­Rain is forecast in Fluffytown, but Love Monster is excited because his friends are coming round for an indoor activity day. They're going to knit onesies, drink hot chocolate and build a pillow fort! But when the weather turns out to be glorious, Love Monster's friends want to play outside instead. Eventually Love Monster is convinced to join them but when he does, it rains! Disappointed, his friends start to head back inside, but Love Monster says they can do his indoor activities outdoors!

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: While in search of a boiling river, Kwazii and Paani meet some tamarin monkeys.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Old Brown takes Peter's journal, Peter must choose between holding on to his most precious possession and saving a friend.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Colby is worried about his first check-up, so Vida and Popcorn help him feel better.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea lures Supertato and Tomato into her cave of frosted doom. Can they find the courage to avoid her traps and retrieve The Lost Candle of Birthdays for Tomato’s Museum?

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings are determined to touch a shooting star and steal Weasy's model rocket to fly into the night sky. Weasy leaps into action to stop them.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Tao needs help learning to fly his new wingsuit for a big town event, and Mojo and Bo are the experts. Can they help him find his inner bird before it’s too late?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The kids want Mum and Dad to play whale watching, but they are tired after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help flip him off, but they still need to find one more friend.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog starts sleepwalking, wreaking havoc in the forest. Pearl and Gadabout need to work together to help him, but they can’t seem to put their personal disagreements aside.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Andy and Jen discover a meteorite crater on Dino Island. But when a grumpy old Ankylosaurus charges through their camp, taking with it all of Andy’s clothes from the washing line, they head out on an epic adventure to save it from falling into the newly found crater. Along the way, Andy meets a velociraptor and a sleepy T. rex, whose roar he needs to record on his gizmo!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle has so much fun on a doggy playdate at Mr Willow's house that he decides to stay for a sleepover! The Brooklyn-Bells miss Waffle and can't wait for his return.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi is busy making a half birthday card for baby Oscar, but with ukulele practice, library reading and Teacup the dog to play with, she has a lot to do. She wishes for more versions of herself, and four colourful Rafis appear. Chaos ensues, until Dash encourages Rafi to take charge. She gets each Rafi to focus on one job - crafts, reading, music and play. At the café, the Rafis sing for Oscar, present the card, and then merge back into one.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are on the beach enjoying a Captain Chloe book about castle adventures. JoJo wants to play along and looks out to sea for Captain Chloe, but she discovers that she must use her imagination. Spotting a nearby castle, Gran Gran takes JoJo on a special trip. Bonnie gives them a tour, but JoJo’s confused - why is the castle in ruins? JoJo uses her imagination to think about what each room was used for and creates a story about a pirate queen who lives in the castle with her pirate knight, played by Panda. JoJo even thinks there’s a room where the pirate queen kept her secret treasure!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. The librarian has lost his big reference book and Sarah thinks her toy periscope might help with the search.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Small is bored, Tiny, Major and Mother are all too busy. Mother suggests he asks Granny to play with him. He is doubtful, but he couldn't have been more mistaken as she takes him on an adventure to a place he has never seen before.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo plays with a block which is red like MeMo, and BaBa plays with a block that is yellow like BaBa. The friends continue across Planet BeddyByes and see more examples of their special colours: a yellow Tweetie, red and yellow Yummies, and a yellow omelette with red tomatoes. On the Lullaby Lake, reds and yellows mix in the setting sun to create a new, special colour.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Series for preschool children. In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read bedtime stories. Everyone is riding on the Pinky Ponk when the ding dong alarm goes. The Pinky Ponk goes up, up and over and down, down and under. Everyone has a very adventurous ride.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: A different story read each night just before bedtime.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: It’s almost bedtime, but Maddie doesn’t want to brush her teeth. Dad tells her all about the mysterious pearly whites (aka her teeth!), and how they sometimes start to sing when they’re tickled. Really, singing teeth? It couldn’t be true… Could it?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Fine Forest is buzzing with excitement as the Fine Forest Drums Festival approaches. The Piggies make a lot of drums for everyone, but they mysteriously disappear. The Piggies create a huge drum and hide inside to uncover this mystery.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a lady trying to make a picnic bench, fitting planks of wood together. Her dog comes to tell her it is time for a walk. Whilst she is away, the Twirlywoos start fitting together the planks of wood - but are they following the instructions for the picnic bench or making something completely different? The Twirlywoo Screen is showing a collection of bones. Fitting together, they make up a skeleton, a dancing skeleton. The Twirlywoos join in the dance.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends visit a fairy-tale castle for a musical adventure, while Fairy Godmother Tumble has a fairy-tale adventure of his own – will Tumble Ted make it to the ball?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa's bouncy ball makes a mess in Home Dome, where the other Teletubbies have just sat down to eat bowls of yummy tubby custard. In Tummy Tales, the children blow up a big bouncy ball and play with it in the park.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Remi, Otis, George, Holly, DJ, Luke and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Cardboard Tubes which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate cardboard tubes inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The popular song ‘Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children plant sunflower seeds in decorated pots to grow beautiful flowers, learn British Sign Language signs for garden, grow and pretty, then sing and sign Mary, Mary, Quite Contrary.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron and the Buds explore the wonderful world of climbing plants, discovering how ivy, sweet peas and raspberries grow tall and reach up for the sun in clever, twisty ways!

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Giraffe Twiggy is feeling happy but doesn’t know why. Her friends tell her what makes them happy. Hamza looks for antelope in the wild and spends time with Alcatraz the tortoise.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou helps Sorry with her anxiety.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey's house has fairies! Tails are being braided, stickers are everywhere, and Mum's got a peg beard. Now the family must band together to hunt for these invisible mischief-makers.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When the Squirrels find Duggee playing the saxophone, they want to have a go, too. Several pots, balloons, tins, tubes and some water later, and the Squirrels are making music. And boy, are they loud!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Sing along with Orange as she helps Indigo and Violet to colour a rainbow.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Harrison wants to find out all about crane flies in today’s episode. Rory and Sandy head to a nature reserve to try to spot them, and Chantelle meets a bug expert in in his garden. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of Harrison’s questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, crane flies are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Rory, Sandy and Zoe make their legs grow with the help of some stilts, as they discover what it’s like having long legs like a crane fly!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: It’s Mummy’s birthday! Henry, Sophie and Mama go on a secret shopping trip to find the perfect present. Back at home, Henry plans out a treasure map and sends Mummy on a heroic birthday adventure. Can she brave the hot lava? And will she find her presents?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen and Small pretend to be knights in the cafe today. Small finds out how naan bread is made, and they cook a perfect dhal recipe for Denzil the Dragon.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Newfoundland Sylvie is a big therapy dog with big soft cuddles who loves to help people when they’re worried. She and her owner Katrina visit all sorts of people every day, young and old. Sylvie and her owner Katrina are helping a girl called Akilah, who is joining the local school after arriving from a foreign country. Lots of things will be very different for her, so Sylvie will need her super heart to make her feel as welcome as possible. After meeting Akilah and her mum, along with Fred the teaching assistant, Sylvie takes her to the school hall for some lunch, stopping to admire some artwork along the way. Then Sylvie acts as Akilah’s furry tour guide on a whistlestop tour of the school, including a trip to the library, before guiding her to her new classroom to meet the teacher and all her new friends. There will be lots of new faces, and everyone will be talking in a language she’s still learning - but with Sylvie and her super heart by her side, Akilah is sure to make lots of friends.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: As the children arrive, there is a rainbow over the school. Mrs Farrell points it out to Bryn before they head inside to create their own rainbow on the carpet. The rainbow has disappeared and the rain has stopped, so some of the children go outside for a game of hide-and-seek in the forest area. They soon find a hammock and take it in turns to try it out whilst the others sing a nursery rhyme. Back inside, it’s time for some more nursery rhymes with music teacher Miss Usher. After a Hickory Dickory Dock warm-up, the children form a marching band for the Grand Old Duke of York.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: While Zoe helps Doug with his homework project about Alaska, Simon and Jess take Waffle and Evie to the shops to buy new school shoes. But Waffle's attempts to help end up causing chaos.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Baba and Lala have found something very exciting - a great big dandelion puff! When they blow the seeds away, they are very disappointed that there is no more 'fluffy'. When Mama spots one seed left, they plant it outside the burrow and wait for it to grow. Baba and Lala decide to watch the dandelion until it turns into a 'fluffy', but they must wait a long time for a new one to appear.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: As everyone huddles in Sonny’s caravan during a storm, Toad admits he’s frightened of the sound. Can Yukee find a way to use the pitter-pitter-pitter-patter of the rain to calm him?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: While looking for a spoon for her yogurt, Maddie realises that all the teaspoons have gone missing - it's like they all got up and marched off! Maddie is on hand to find a surprisingly musical way to get them back where they belong.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The Bunnies' sleeping mobile breaks, so the Piggy Builders come up with great ideas to create a new one. But the improvements amuse the Bunnies so much that they are too excited to sleep!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Uh-oh. Unlucky Thirteen falls apart whenever anyone mentions his name. Learn all about the number 13 with Numberblock Thirteen!

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: N likes to say no - but he meets his match when the dog, the cat and the pig won't help him make his bread. This episode has fun with the words dog, dig, cat, cut, pig, pick, mill, mix, hot and ten.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Mr Tumble tidies up his bedroom. Meanwhile, Justin and his friends play in a recycling band!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: A red balloon floats into Teletubbyland and Po leads the tubby phone dance in a special episode about Po's favourite colour. Po shows the Tiddlytubbies the red balloon and all of the Teletubbies watch children play in a room full of red balloons.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 85 million years to meet a giant feathered dinosaur that is as tall as a house! Along the way, he helps to protect a nest full of prehistoric eggs and gets caught in a super-sized sand storm.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the ‘chatterbox’ and remembers the day she got it… Alice is showing the kids how to make a ‘chatterbox’ when she gets a call from her mum Gloria, who lives in Canada. Mrs Juniper and Moira are bickering, and Caitlin decides to write cheeky messages in her ‘chatterbox’, which doesn’t help matters. Alice breaks some bad news to James.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are all made to help us get around cities easier. Grace first takes an electric scooter car for a spin, then shows off an amazing hydrogen train and goes for a cycle in a fold-up electric bike!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: A Very Important Pup visits Pup School for the grand opening of the school's brand new bug hotel. It's Dodge's special job to show the VIP around the school, but things don't go to plan. Dodge feels like he has let everyone down and thinks the VIP won't want to stay to open the new hotel... but things turn out very differently.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: ­Rain is forecast in Fluffytown, but Love Monster is excited because his friends are coming round for an indoor activity day. They're going to knit onesies, drink hot chocolate and build a pillow fort! But when the weather turns out to be glorious, Love Monster's friends want to play outside instead. Eventually Love Monster is convinced to join them but when he does, it rains! Disappointed, his friends start to head back inside, but Love Monster says they can do his indoor activities outdoors!

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: While in search of a boiling river, Kwazii and Paani meet some tamarin monkeys.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Old Brown takes Peter's journal, Peter must choose between holding on to his most precious possession and saving a friend.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Colby is worried about his first check-up, so Vida and Popcorn help him feel better.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea lures Supertato and Tomato into her cave of frosted doom. Can they find the courage to avoid her traps and retrieve The Lost Candle of Birthdays for Tomato’s Museum?

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings are determined to touch a shooting star and steal Weasy's model rocket to fly into the night sky. Weasy leaps into action to stop them.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Tao needs help learning to fly his new wingsuit for a big town event, and Mojo and Bo are the experts. Can they help him find his inner bird before it’s too late?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The kids want Mum and Dad to play whale watching, but they are tired after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help flip him off, but they still need to find one more friend.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog starts sleepwalking, wreaking havoc in the forest. Pearl and Gadabout need to work together to help him, but they can’t seem to put their personal disagreements aside.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Andy and Jen discover a meteorite crater on Dino Island. But when a grumpy old Ankylosaurus charges through their camp, taking with it all of Andy’s clothes from the washing line, they head out on an epic adventure to save it from falling into the newly found crater. Along the way, Andy meets a velociraptor and a sleepy T. rex, whose roar he needs to record on his gizmo!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle has so much fun on a doggy playdate at Mr Willow's house that he decides to stay for a sleepover! The Brooklyn-Bells miss Waffle and can't wait for his return.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi is busy making a half birthday card for baby Oscar, but with ukulele practice, library reading and Teacup the dog to play with, she has a lot to do. She wishes for more versions of herself, and four colourful Rafis appear. Chaos ensues, until Dash encourages Rafi to take charge. She gets each Rafi to focus on one job - crafts, reading, music and play. At the café, the Rafis sing for Oscar, present the card, and then merge back into one.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are on the beach enjoying a Captain Chloe book about castle adventures. JoJo wants to play along and looks out to sea for Captain Chloe, but she discovers that she must use her imagination. Spotting a nearby castle, Gran Gran takes JoJo on a special trip. Bonnie gives them a tour, but JoJo’s confused - why is the castle in ruins? JoJo uses her imagination to think about what each room was used for and creates a story about a pirate queen who lives in the castle with her pirate knight, played by Panda. JoJo even thinks there’s a room where the pirate queen kept her secret treasure!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. The librarian has lost his big reference book and Sarah thinks her toy periscope might help with the search.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Small is bored, Tiny, Major and Mother are all too busy. Mother suggests he asks Granny to play with him. He is doubtful, but he couldn't have been more mistaken as she takes him on an adventure to a place he has never seen before.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo plays with a block which is red like MeMo, and BaBa plays with a block that is yellow like BaBa. On the Lullaby Lake, reds and yellows mix in the setting sun to create a new, special colour.

programme.desc: Series for preschool children. In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read bedtime stories. programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. Tom cooks up a feast to honour the harvest: a fig and extra virgin olive oil cake. His journey then takes him to Lazio, where rocket is an obsession. Giancarlo, a local producer, shows him how they get a peppery intensity into the leaves through careful cultivation. After a hard day's work Tom cooks his take on a family favourite: rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with a pesto pasta salad.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip. Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Barcelona to take on The Vixen and The Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip. Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Barcelona to take on The Vixen and The Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. Following a competitive opening quiz and a series of city-wide challenges - including hunting for graffiti art, tackling a theme park drop ride, and playing a football shirt game - the competition remains unpredictable and the race is tight with a dramatic finale.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. Tom cooks up a feast to honour the harvest: a fig and extra virgin olive oil cake. His journey then takes him to Lazio, where rocket is an obsession. Giancarlo, a local producer, shows him how they get a peppery intensity into the leaves through careful cultivation. After a hard day's work Tom cooks his take on a family favourite: rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with a pesto pasta salad.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip. Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Barcelona to take on The Vixen and The Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. Following a competitive opening quiz and a series of city-wide challenges - including hunting for graffiti art, tackling a theme park drop ride, and playing a football shirt game - the competition remains unpredictable and the race is tight with a dramatic finale.

In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. Tom cooks up a feast to honour the harvest: a fig and extra virgin olive oil cake. His journey then takes him to Lazio, where rocket is an obsession. Giancarlo, a local producer, shows him how they get a peppery intensity into the leaves through careful cultivation. After a hard day's work Tom cooks his take on a family favourite: rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with a pesto pasta salad.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip. Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Barcelona to take on The Vixen and The Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. Following a competitive opening quiz and a series of city-wide challenges - including hunting for graffiti art, tackling a theme park drop ride, and playing a football shirt game - the competition remains unpredictable and the race is tight with a dramatic finale.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. Tom cooks up a feast to honour the harvest: a fig and extra virgin olive oil cake. His journey then takes him to Lazio, where rocket is an obsession. Giancarlo, a local producer, shows him how they get a peppery intensity into the leaves through careful cultivation. After a hard day's work Tom cooks his take on a family favourite: rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with a pesto pasta salad.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World

Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Barcelona to take on The Vixen and The Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. Following a competitive opening quiz and a series of city-wide challenges - including hunting for graffiti art, tackling a theme park drop ride, and playing a football shirt game - the competition remains unpredictable and the race is tight with a dramatic finale.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. Tom cooks up a feast to honour the harvest: a fig and extra virgin olive oil cake. His journey then takes him to Lazio, where rocket is an obsession. Giancarlo, a local producer, shows him how they get a peppery intensity into the leaves through careful cultivation. After a hard day's work Tom cooks his take on a family favourite: rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with a pesto pasta salad.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip. Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Barcelona to take on The Vixen and The Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. Following a competitive opening quiz and a series of city-wide challenges - including hunting for graffiti art, tackling a theme park drop ride, and playing a football shirt game - the competition remains unpredictable and the race is tight with a dramatic finale.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.desc: Animated comedy about Bob Belcher, who runs Bob's Burgers restaurant, and his family. programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: The first episode of a comedy series providing an honest, uplifting and heart-warming portrayal of the lives of working-class teenagers from Liverpool while tackling issues with a refreshing humour. Recently-orphaned Southerner Christopher goes to live with his nan on a council estate in Liverpool - there he forms an unlikely unholy alliance with working-class Reece. On the verge of being expelled, Reece convinces his school's headmaster to give him one last chance and allow him to mentor Christopher to prove that he can positively contribute to the school - despite their differences, a friendship develops between the pair until Christopher throws Reece under the bus in order to impress a girl. An angry Reece can't resist getting his revenge on Christopher, but will this ruin his chances of remaining at the school? Meanwhile, Aimee reluctantly gives her boyfriend Lewis a gift to help with his sexual needs, but she soon learns that he has been cheating on her and seeks revenge...

programme.title: Fort Algiers
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Lesley Selander. Stars Yvonne De Carlo, Carlos Thompson & Raymond Burr. In northwest Africa, a tribal leader tries to stir up a rebellion against the ruling powers. [S]

programme.title: Zombies
programme.desc: Short documentary film detailing the contributions zombie films have made to the horror genre in the last 60 years, including Night Of The Living Dead and White Zombie, starring Bela Lugosi

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Arsonist. Western with Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray, who run a stagecoach line in the Old West where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress. [S]

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: The Pigeons Of Paris. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. End of the Line. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Make Me An Offer
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Directed by Cyril Frankel. Starring Peter Finch. The story of Charlie, who as a boy fell in love with a Portland Vase on a trip to a museum, pursues his dream as an antiques dealer. [S]

programme.title: The Kidnappers
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Philip Leacock. Stars: Jon Whiteley, Vincent Winter, Adrienne Corri, Duncan Macrae, Jean Anderson. Two Canadian orphans 'borrow' a baby to raise as their own. [S]

programme.title: House of Blackmail
programme.desc: 1953. Crime. Directed by Maurice Elvey. An Army officer (William Sylvester) and Carol (Mary Germaine) must solve the murder of a blackmailer or be charged themselves. [S]

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: Trail's End
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by Robert Florey. Stars Dick Powell, Lee Van Cleef & Richard Hale. A famous marshal of Dodge City sets out in search of the murderous Sonoma Kid and stumbles upon a tragedy. [S]

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Police Killer. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. 37 year old Detective Sergeant Robert Kidd was murdered in September 1895. His life taken in the line of duty. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Maid of Somerset. 1957. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. A girl ask for Sir Lancelot's help with the evil King Meliot who is selling the young men of Cheddar into slavery. [S]

programme.title: Commandos Strike at Dawn
programme.desc: 1942. War. Directed by John Farrow. Stars Anna Lee, Paul Muni & Ray Collins. A Norwegian fisherman, enraged at the Nazi atrocities against his village, sets out to seek revenge and restore peace. [S]

programme.title: The Super Secret Service
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Directed by Charles W. Green. Stars Peter Sellers, Graham Stark, Dick Emery & Raymond Francis. Brilliantly bizarre comedy short about the workings of the 'Super Secret Service'. [S]

programme.title: The Winslow Boy
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Anthony Asquith. Stars Robert Donat, Cedric Hardwicke & Basil Radford. Pre-WWI England, a youngster is expelled from a naval academy for theft. His parents demand a trial. [S]

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: Chingle Hall/Psychic Detective: Part 1. 1996. Michael Aspel explores the ghostly presence at the 700 year old manor house Chingle Hall and the baffling story of American psychic Dixie Yetarian. [S]

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Trade Wind. 1974. Stars Jean Anderson, Julia Goodman & Hilary Tindall. Barbara finds a way of settling Johnny's debts. David places the Board under pressure to release Jill's financial guarantee. [S]

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Short Cut to Murder. 1959. Donald Gray, Margaret Anderson & Kenneth Edwards. Saber is called in to prove the innocence of a man after a robbery and a murder in the same house as his bride to be. [S]

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters...
programme.desc: ...Social Club. Episode 8. 1974. Brotherhood of Man sings 'Reach Out Your Hands'. Russ Conway plays 'Side Saddle', 'Toy Balloons' and 'Bordello'. PJ Proby sings 'Somewhere'/'I Know You Know'. [S]

programme.title: Nobody Runs Forever
programme.desc: 1968. Action. Director: Ralph Thomas. Stars Christopher Plummer, Rod Taylor & Lilli Palmer. An Australian detective arrives in London to arrest a top diplomat for the murder of his first wife. [S]

programme.title: She Played with Fire
programme.desc: 1958. Drama. Directed by Sidney Gilliat. Stars Jack Hawkins, Ian Hunter, Arlene Dahl & Dennis Price. An investigator finds himself involved in blackmail and murder after running into his ex. [S]

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. Tom cooks up a feast to honour the harvest: a fig and extra virgin olive oil cake. His journey then takes him to Lazio, where rocket is an obsession. Giancarlo, a local producer, shows him how they get a peppery intensity into the leaves through careful cultivation. After a hard day's work Tom cooks his take on a family favourite: rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with a pesto pasta salad.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip. Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Barcelona to take on The Vixen and The Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. Following a competitive opening quiz and a series of city-wide challenges - including hunting for graffiti art, tackling a theme park drop ride, and playing a football shirt game - the competition remains unpredictable and the race is tight with a dramatic finale.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. Tom cooks up a feast to honour the harvest: a fig and extra virgin olive oil cake. His journey then takes him to Lazio, where rocket is an obsession. Giancarlo, a local producer, shows him how they get a peppery intensity into the leaves through careful cultivation. After a hard day's work Tom cooks his take on a family favourite: rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with a pesto pasta salad.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip. Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Barcelona to take on The Vixen and The Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. Following a competitive opening quiz and a series of city-wide challenges - including hunting for graffiti art, tackling a theme park drop ride, and playing a football shirt game - the competition remains unpredictable and the race is tight with a dramatic finale.
